title: One in four Ellsworth missile security police saw something
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: one out of every four has probably seen something in the night sky

plain: Among the security police guarding nuclear missiles at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in the 1970s, about one in four probably saw something unexplained in the night sky. Mario Woods, a former guard at those missile sites, says so on the show, putting it as "one out of every four has probably seen something in the night sky." If he is right, sightings around the missiles were common among the men on duty, not rare one-off events.
